why: Every readable result is either a health-authority page about insulin temperature rules and ice-pack coolers (CDC, GOES, hospital blogs), an unreadable PDF, or an Anker brand blog. None tests or even specifies a power station plus mini fridge/medication cooler and tells the shopper how many hours it lasts. The one niche review (New World Survival) covers medication coolers only and stops at "runs from a power station." No major reviewer or authority answers the actual equipment-and-runtime question, so a focused page with a tested station+cooler pairing, measured Wh draw, 48-hour runtime math, current prices and codes would be the only direct answer in the set.
